_note: The five rarity tiers: how often each is drawn, and what it looks like. Weight is relative within a draw before luck is applied; `luckScaling` is how much a point of luck pushes toward that tier, so luck makes good cards likelier without ever making commons impossible. Colour and badge are the visual contract the UI renders — one place, so a tier means the same thing on a level-up card, a shop card and a Homestead card.
_designNote: Order matters: tiers are listed commonest first and the UI may rely on that for sorting.
